metadata.title: Services — Enzo Interiors
metadata.description: Fitted kitchens, bedrooms, wardrobes and media walls, drawn for your room and built in our Leicester workshop. See where each discipline starts and what is included.

hero.lede: Drawn for your room, built in our Leicester workshop, fitted by the people who made it.

pricing.label: Scale
pricing.lede: Entry specification, typical room, everything included. Plotted on one scale so you can see how the disciplines actually compare before you talk to anyone.

footnote.lead: Starting prices are the entry specification for a typical room.
footnote.tail: Your own figure comes from the survey — we do not price a room we have not measured.

constants.label: Constant
constants.lede: Whichever discipline you pick, and whatever it costs, these are fixed. They are the reason the schedule above is worth trusting.

items.title: One team, start to finish
items.body: The person who measures your room is the person who draws it, and our own fitters install it. No subcontractors, no handovers, nobody blaming the last trade.

items.title: Surveyed before it is quoted
items.body: We come to you, measure every wall, and photograph the space before a number is written down. A quote given over the phone is a guess.

items.title: Drawn in 3D before it is cut
items.body: You see the room you are buying — finishes, handles, internal layout — and sign it off before a single sheet goes on the saw.

items.title: Five-year workmanship guarantee
items.body: Every installation, every discipline, in writing. If something we fitted moves, sticks or fails, we come back and put it right.

questions.lede: The questions that come up whichever discipline you are looking at. Each service page answers its own on top of these.

closing.lede: A free survey, in your own home. We measure every wall, photograph the space, and tell you honestly what is worth doing — before anybody writes a number down.

question.legend: Which room are we looking at?
